notes.title: The New Sprite And New Area Update
notes.content:
The first major update to Elderine: Dreams to Destiny is finally here.  To enjoy this update a new game will need to be started.  Some of the bug that were fixed require a new save, so some old save games wont work and will show an error message about missing sprite files. 

All Character and NPC sprites have been updated
Enjoy exploring the world of Elderine: Dreams to Destiny with beautifully redesigned sprites.  Jason and friends will encounter familiar faces and new friends in the world, all in higher quality.  Check out all the Sprites in the image below. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27556763/4fbc938b82446247ead4ae139ca70aac95a05579.jpg

Explore a new area: Firwood
The corruption from the north has been spreading.  The once majestic Firwood Forest has been corrupted, explore this new area and uncover the cause of the corruption.  There are many secrets in this strange forest.  Very old with many ruins, who knows what strange things you will find here.  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27556763/4cdd98fc1c1d41f79a26c4e1da7883201ab7169c.jpg

Traps, Puzzles and Movable Objects
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27556763/33dba403c22d7a2206a2b5d597add0712a6f0985.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27556763/867fa0e8c8596f10a860131d3894929f5d23e382.jpg

Updates

Added New Sprites for all characters.
Added New Area - ]Firwood
Added New Monster - Enraged Wisp
New Music tracks by Steven Settinger
Fixed walking through bushes water shadow not showing.
Added new background for Menus System and graphical cursor
Added two New Recipe Books
Added the Treasure Hunt Quests
Added Repeat Quests
Added different types of healing potion
New Item: [spoiler]Added a method to teleport to your farm (New Recipe)[/spoiler]
New Item: [spoiler]Added an item that will let you move boulders![/spoiler]
New Item: [spoiler]Added an item that lets you cast a ranged magic attack (New Recipe)[/spoiler]
Added Traps
Added movable boulders
Treasure chest popup - showing you what you have found.
Removed a lot of the in game health pots (you need to rely on potions)
Added more resources you can gather. 
Item buy/sell price re-balanced
Item quantity for crafting re-balanced
Jason walking recalibrated
Text is now text-wrapped - fixed sentence cut off, mid sentence.
 

Known Bugs

The shield skill does not block properly


More to come

New area
More craftable items
Bug fixing - when found

notes.title: Elderine Update 20 - Full Controller Support + Bug Fixes
notes.content:
It's never good to get stuck when you're trying to take part in an epic adventure!  Especially if it's an art class!

Today's update fixes a few bugs, introduces newly updated plugins for the battle system, input configuration (you can change key bindings from the options) and full gamepad support. 

Change Log

Due to plugin changes and follower removal, a New Game is strongly recommended!

Added:

    Full gamepad support
    Input Configuration - Change key bindings.
    New Plugins to support action battles.
    Some more quests.
    Some hidden chests


Bug Fixes:

    School map bugs - getting stuck.
    Underground passge - map redraw and collision bug fixes.
    Elderine Forest - map redraw and collision bug fixes.
    Glen Tirel Carrots?? You mean Parsotas!
    Some Bill boards showing wrong info.


Changes:

    Removed followers - you only see you now.

notes.title: Elderine Update 19 - Quests and Esteem?
notes.content:
Hey Adventurers!  trekking the land, rescuing folk, gathering strange crops for old farmers?  Feeling a little annoyed with the "Esteem" they have given you?
Worry not, for today is a great day for you Esteem collectors, yes today you can finally use Esteem!  Hoorah!

Today's update adds a few new features to the game and makes use of something that was already there but not used, Esteem points.

When you completed a Quest in Elderine you were either awarded a small item (potions, seeds, etc) or a small token of the Quest Givers thanks, Esteem.  However, until today, those esteem points were not very useful.

Added:

    New Esteem count in the HUD
    More Esteem Quests added
    Repeatable Esteem Quests added
    Another person to rescue (perhaps they know more about Esteem)
    A feature to use Esteem (it's an Esteem shop... more items will be added soon)


Bug Fixes:

    Fixed gathering items made graphic disappear then reappear.
    Getting stuck in school art class


Coming Soon:

    New travel location (continue game after final Boss)
    More Esteem items (weapons, pets, rare cool items of magical properties)
    Magic School
    Pets - to collect
    Add in more Relics to collect
    More Quests

notes.title: Elderine Update 17 - Alignment and New locations
notes.content:
Changelog: Build: 2574590


    Added: two locations where you can donate to make your alignment more Good, 
    Updated: Northern Plains Map - added more interactive signs and update maps. 


In terms of alignment - once you reach a certain level of Good you will have extra interactive options in certain places, and be rewarded.  Goodness brings strength. 

If you go Evil, you will soon be able to intereact with those of a darker nature.  Some options will alter certain aspects of the game.  Do you really need all your friends... alive?  Is a sacrafice worth new power?

notes.title: Elderine Update 15 - New Travel, New GFX. bug fixes, new areas
notes.content:
Hi all, 

I published a few patches over the past week.  Please see changelog below with fixes/changes.  As always, please let me know if you spot any bugs, or have any ideas.

Changelog: Build: 2573879

    Added: Icons to show exits on maps.  Finding your way around should be much easier. 
    Added: New tree graphics for starting location
    Added: New graphics for rusty pipe weapon and fishing rod. 
    Added: New Crop types and graphics.  No more Carrots :)
    Added: Updated grass graphics in starting location
    Added: Added final Dungeon with "Final" Boss
    Added: New items to craft - A magical stone to warp close to your base.
    Added: Blimp Ticket sales person in Northern Plains
    Added: More mobs in certain areas.
    Added: Some mobs now drop gold.
    Fixed: some narrative typos
    Fixed: Elderine Forest Dungeon bugs that stopped progression
    Fixed: Health of some bosses - they werent very boss like. 
    Fixed: Some mapping issues in starting areas and underground. 
    Removed: Old save points and replaced with new save points.


And a few other minor things to help make the game better. 

Coming up next:

    Next: more side quests - Find and gather and return for reward
    Next: More materials to harvest
    Next: More items to craft - weapons to upgrade.

notes.title: Elderine Update 13 - Small Harvesting Update
notes.content:
Hey all,

So,  I have added four new types of harvest items into the game.  At the moment they are more for collecting and selling than anything else.   You will find these new harvest "crops" in the Southern and Nothern Plains. 

If you haven't found "Haspar Mines and Lumber" yet it was added a while back and offers a place to chop trees, and mine some ore.  You'll need an axe and a pick axe though...

Ores are essential in the game, and will be used to craft weapons and items that will help you progress later in the story.   Of course, you'll also need to rescue a few people and restore your base of activities before you can really do any of this.

More updates coming soon, and as always, any bugs, thoughts, comments and suggestions are always welcome!

Alan

notes.title: Week Long Sale starting 27th March 20% off - Plus Updates!
notes.content:
Hey all, 

Elderine: Dreams to Destiny be on sale with  20% discount as a part of the week long sale starting 27th March.  If you haven't already bought Elderine, now is a great time to buy. 

Let's Play videos on Youtube:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL49e5k5yp64zFq_qV8b-PrvQeE4b3tDGp

Updates Coming April:

    Final Dungeon
    Final story scene
    Updates to the farm/base area with more content*
    More quests added
    New item drops
    More crafting options
    More story interaction with Kate (Kate side-story)
    More original Music


*Updates to the Farm/Basel:
Although the farming/base aspect of Elderine is not the main focus of the game, it is an area that can add some more activities, and enjoyment.  At the moment players can farm, rescue people, buy craft books, and store any artifacts they have found.  However, I would like to continue to develop this area to offer more things to do.

    More types of crops to grow
    More people to rescue
    Join the slavers - evil
    Fight the slavers - good
    New Quests
    More base upgrades - that will enable other features.
    More companion story line interaction.


Early Access:
Although it will be possible to "complete" Elderine in one of the next updates in April, there is still much more that I would like to add, having received great feedback from players.  As such I will continue to keep Elderine in Early Access for longer and add new game elements and polish others.  That being said, once the game comes out of early access, i will still be working on additional, free, content for Elderine, includeing a new area and quest line that will continue on from the end game story.

As always, if you have any feedback, suggestions, ideas of items, tales of monster slaying or words of encouragement, please do let me know!

notes.title: Elderine Update 6
notes.content:
Hi all,

I have implemented a new save/load option for the game.

Save slot one will be listed as Auto save, and any auto save/save crystal save will save to slot 1.   You will also be able to save to other slots manually.

This may have overwritten your current save files.   If it has you can use the building behind Jason's house to skip the school part of the game and go straight to the strange hut in the woods.

I am hoping that this new save game plugin will remove the save game bugs. 

Alan

notes.title: Elderine Update 3
notes.content:
Hey All,

Thanks for all the feedback so far.  It's been great.  Progress may be slow but I am getting there with adding or fixing certain parts of the game.  I always like to have a bit of a balance between the too, and i hope you enjoy the updates. 

As there are quite a few changes, you may wish to start again.  If you have bene experiencing game crashes or if you manually saved over save slot 1, i would suggest starting again. 

I have also removed manual save and added more save crstals.  I am hoping this will avoid conflicts within the game that have been causing crashes. 


Patch Notes Feb 11th:

Added:

    More areas in the game - 2nd final dungeon. 
    More Music
    More crafting options (metal work, magical items) This is still basic.
    Copper mines (other mines to come and wood chopping)
    Monster drops :)
    An NPC (you meet in Haspar) who will become the shop keeper at your farm and sell you useful items, and buy your loot. 


Fixed:

    Hopefully some areas that freeze the game (sewers in Haspar)
    Instances where you can get repeat quest items. 


Things to come in future updates::

    Final Dungeon
    More varied monsters
    More loot drops
    More crafting options
    More mine types and tress to chop.
    I will start adding in new people to rescue.
    I will start adding in new side quests.
    New places to visit
    End game scene and storyline

notes.title: Elderine Update 1 - Yay
notes.content:
Hi all, 

I have just released a new update which should fix some small bugs.  Please see change log below:

Fixed:

    Colliders/ in Belfast Town area, fixed stairs and objects that could be walked through.


Added:

    Manual Save Option
    Quest Menu (early stages)
    Crafting (Synthesis) Menu (early stages)
    Some more tutorial text at the start of the game. 
    Explore hut - school class progression quest. 
    Introduced hovering icons over items that you can interact with (not all items though)


For the new menu options, you should see these after game you update Elderine.  However if you start a new game you will see what the quest system will be like.  Quest 1 introduced which is to eventually explore the hut.  The quest provides guidance on what rooms to go to etc in school.
